CAPS.sub: From positioning and identity to campaigns, funnels and pipeline. Strategy and execution planned together, reported in one place.
CAPS.intro: A strong brand with no distribution goes unseen. Campaigns built on a weak brand cost more and convert less. We work on both: the foundations that make you worth choosing, and the marketing that puts you in front of the right buyers.

faqs: Do you guarantee leads or return on ad spend?
No. We commit to the deliverables, reporting and optimisation agreed in scope. Results depend on your market, offer, budget and sales follow-up, and we’ll tell you plainly what the data shows.
Can you work alongside our in-house team or current agency?
Yes. We can take on a single channel, or coordinate the plan while your team runs parts of it.
Who owns the ad accounts and data?
You do. Campaigns run in accounts registered to your business, with access granted to us for the engagement.

CAPS.h1: Websites, apps and systems, built to launch and built to last.
CAPS.sub: Design, development, integrations, deployment and maintenance, with clear ownership of your code and data from day one.
CAPS.intro: Good technology work is more than a launch date. It means a product your team can update, systems that talk to each other, and someone accountable when something breaks. We scope carefully, build in milestones you approve, and document everything we hand over.

groups.title: Websites and commerce
items: Responsive, fast business websites with a content management system your team can update.
Campaign, launch and lead-generation pages designed for one job: conversion.
Catalogues, carts, checkout, marketplace workflows and order management.
Event sites with ticketing, registration and QR check-in built in.

Native or cross-platform mobile apps, chosen to fit your product, budget and roadmap.
Research, wireframes, interface design and clickable prototypes, tested with users before development starts.
The business logic, databases, authentication and APIs your products and integrations depend on.

items: Practical AI in your workflows: document processing, support automation and productivity tools.
CRM customisation, internal dashboards and digitised processes that fit how your team works.
Payment gateways, calendars, booking, email and messaging connected to your product.

faqs: Who owns the code?

Ownership is set out in your contract before work starts. Our standard terms [transfer code and IP ownership to you on full payment — confirm in contract template], and we document every third-party dependency and licence at handover.
What happens after launch?
You can choose a maintenance agreement covering updates, backups, security patches and support, with response times agreed in writing.
How do you price development?
Defined scopes are priced as fixed projects paid in milestones. Evolving products can run on a monthly or time-and-materials basis. Either way, you see the plan before you pay.

CAPS.name: Media & Content
CAPS.card: Personal branding, podcasts from concept to publishing, video production and content repurposing.
CAPS.h1: Your expertise, produced and put to work.
CAPS.sub: Personal branding, podcasts, video and content, from concept and studio setup to editing, repurposing and publishing.
CAPS.intro: The people who run businesses usually have the most valuable things to say and the least time to say them. We build the format, run the production and turn each session into content for every channel, so your time goes into ideas rather than editing timelines.

groups.title: Personal branding
items: Positioning for founders, CEOs, investors and professionals, built around real expertise rather than a persona.
Thought leadership in your voice: narratives, posts and an editorial calendar you approve.
A personal site with your biography, portfolio, speaking profile and a clear way to get in touch.
Interviews, founder stories and executive messages, filmed professionally.

groups.title: Podcasts
items: Name, format, audience, episode structure and a launch plan for a show with a clear purpose.
Acoustics, lighting, cameras, microphones and set design for a studio in your own space.
Studio or remote, single or multi-camera, with recording run by a production crew.
Audio and video editing, mixing, colour grading, artwork and thumbnails, published to your channels.

groups.title: Content and production
items: One recording, interview or webinar turned into a library of short videos, posts and carousels.
Brand films, product shoots, corporate videos and campaign creative.
Reels, Shorts, carousels, graphics and motion design, made for each platform.
Founder newsletters and company updates, written and produced on an editorial calendar.

faqs: Do we need our own studio?
No. We can record in a partner studio, at your office or remotely. Studio setup suits teams that record regularly.
How much of my time does founder content take?
We design the process around a recurring interview and an approval step, so your time goes into ideas and sign-off, not drafting.
Who owns the content?
You own the final approved content. Terms for raw footage and project files are agreed in your contract.
CAPS.title: Podcast Production & Founder Content
CAPS.desc: Personal branding, podcast development, studio setup, recording, editing, video production and content repurposing for founders and businesses.

CAPS.name: PR & Reputation
CAPS.menu: Media relations, thought leadership and trust
CAPS.card: Media relations, founder and corporate PR, thought leadership, reputation monitoring and AI search visibility.
CAPS.sub: Media relations, founder visibility, thought leadership and reputation monitoring, run with integrity and reported honestly.
CAPS.intro: Credibility can’t be bought, but it can be built. We find the stories that matter to the publications, podcasts and stages your audience follows, prepare you to tell them well, and keep watch over how your brand is represented, including in AI-powered search.

groups.title: Media and visibility
items: Media research, journalist outreach and pitching for stories that fit what each publication covers.
Profiles, expert commentary and interview pitching that build a leader’s public credibility.
Announcements for product launches, milestones and company news.
Event and speaker announcements, media invitations and press materials that support your event.
Press releases, fact sheets, boilerplate, executive bios and press kits journalists can use.
Find relevant shows, pitch you as a guest and prepare you for the conversation.
Expert articles, conference speaker applications and keynote opportunities.

groups.title: Reputation and trust
items: Track mentions and reviews, analyse what people are saying and set up response workflows.
Playbooks, escalation paths and holding statements prepared before you need them, coordinated with legal and specialist advisers where required.
Review how AI-powered search experiences describe your brand, check the facts and identify ways to strengthen how you’re represented.

faqs: Can you guarantee coverage?

No, and be wary of anyone who does. Journalists and editors decide what they publish. We commit to the research, angles, materials and outreach, and we report on every campaign’s activity and responses.
Do you arrange paid placements?
Only when you ask for them, and they are always labelled as sponsored. We never present paid content as earned coverage.
Do you handle a live crisis?
We help you prepare before one happens. In a live situation, we coordinate communications alongside your legal and specialist advisers.
CAPS.title: PR & Reputation Management
CAPS.desc: Digital PR, founder and corporate PR, thought leadership, podcast guest booking, reputation monitoring and AI search visibility, reported honestly.

CAPS.name: Founder OS
CAPS.menu: Hiring, CRM, processes and operating systems
CAPS.card: Goals, operating systems, SOPs, hiring coordination, sales operations and internal automation.
CAPS.h1: The operating system behind a growing company.
CAPS.sub: Goals, processes, hiring, CRM and automation, set up so your team can run without every decision routing through you.
CAPS.intro: Most early companies run on the founder’s memory. That works until it doesn’t: follow-ups slip, new hires take months to find their feet, and every question lands on one desk. We put the structure in place: clear goals, documented processes, a hiring pipeline and the tools to see it all in one view.

groups.title: Strategy and systems
items: Quarterly goals, OKRs and execution reviews that keep the company focused on what matters most.
One workspace for company priorities, sales, team tasks, marketing, operations and reporting.
Standard operating procedures, checklists and a knowledge base built around how your team works.
Automated internal workflows, meeting documentation and operational dashboards.

groups.title: People and hiring
items: Hiring plans, role definitions and scorecards, ready before the first job post goes live.
Candidate research, application workflows, interview scheduling and pipeline management.
Onboarding plans, documentation and training workflows, with clear responsibilities from day one.
We source and qualify fractional executives, consultants and freelancers when you need senior skills without a full-time hire.

groups.title: Sales and suppliers
items: Sales workflows, follow-up discipline, CRM hygiene and pipeline reporting.
Vendor research, quotation comparison, supplier records and delivery coordination.

faqs: Are you a recruitment agency?
We support your hiring process: planning, sourcing coordination, scheduling and pipeline management. Hiring decisions always stay with you.
Which tools do you use?
We work with the tools you already have where possible, and recommend new ones only when there’s a clear reason. [List your preferred stack once decided.]
Do we need all of this at once?
No. You can start with one gap, such as sales follow-up or hiring, and add the rest as you grow.
CAPS.title: Founder Operations, Hiring & CRM
CAPS.desc: Goals, SOPs, hiring coordination, CRM, sales operations and automation, so your company runs without every decision routing through you.

CAPS.name: Events
CAPS.card: Concept, venue, design, production, ticketing, audience, sponsorship and event-day operations.
CAPS.h1: Events planned with strategy, run with precision.
CAPS.sub: From concept and venue to production, ticketing, audience and event-day operations. One team accountable from brief to wrap.
CAPS.intro: An event is a product with a fixed launch date. It needs a concept worth attending, an audience that shows up, vendors who deliver on time and someone who owns every detail on the day. We plan, coordinate and run it, then turn what happened into content, leads and a report.

groups.title: Planning and design
items: Planning, budgeting, vendor coordination, event-day operations and post-event closure, managed by one lead.
Positioning, format, agenda and audience journey, designed around what the event needs to achieve.
Venue research, comparisons, site visits, availability checks and negotiation support.
Event identity, stage concepts, signage, venue layouts, booths and branded environments.

groups.title: Production and operations
items: AV, LED, sound, lighting, structures, fabrication and furniture, delivered through qualified production vendors.
Speaker coordination, artist logistics, guest lists and VIP hospitality.
Ticket categories, registration, QR check-in and live guest tracking.
Staffing, volunteers, vendor schedules, run-of-show and event-day checklists.

groups.title: Audience, sponsors and follow-up
items: Campaigns, content and outreach that build registrations from the right audience.
Sponsor prospecting, sponsorship proposals and exhibitor outreach.
Personalised digital invitations, RSVP pages, confirmations and reminders.
Event coverage, interviews, highlights and live social content.
Attendance analysis, sponsor deliverables, feedback, lead handover and follow-up campaigns.

faqs: Can you handle just part of our event?
Yes. You can bring us in for a single element, such as venue, production or ticketing, or for the whole event.
Who is responsible for permits, safety and insurance?
We set this out in writing before any vendor is booked: which permits, safety measures and insurance apply, and who holds each one.
Do you guarantee registrations or sponsors?
No. We commit to the campaign plan, outreach and reporting agreed in your scope, and we share progress against targets throughout.
CAPS.title: Event Management & Production
CAPS.desc: End-to-end event management: concept, venue, production, ticketing, audience acquisition, sponsorship support and event-day operations.

CAPS.name: Network & Experiences
CAPS.menu: Distribution partners, communities and brand experiences
CAPS.card: Distribution through creators, publishers and communities, plus curated events and brand activations.
CAPS.h1: Put your story where your audience already is.
CAPS.sub: Content distribution through creators, publishers and communities, plus curated events and brand experiences that bring audiences together.
CAPS.intro: Publishing content is not the same as distributing it. Your audience already gathers in newsletters, podcasts, creator channels and professional communities. We find the ones that fit, agree terms with the people who run them, and connect every placement to something you can track.

groups.title: Content distribution and community
items: Approved content published across the social, editorial and digital channels that suit your audience.
Placements coordinated with relevant creators, publishers and distribution partners.
Permission-based distribution in relevant WhatsApp, Telegram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Discord and industry communities. Never spam.
Reach founders through incubators, accelerators, E-cells and entrepreneurship communities.
Newsletter placements, podcast promotion and cross-promotion with aligned audiences.
Speaker clips, highlights and interviews distributed to extend an event’s reach after the day.
Audience research, channel selection, scheduling, partner coordination and reporting, run as one campaign.
Partners found and qualified by audience, geography, industry and budget.
Distribution connected to landing pages and lead capture, so reach turns into trackable enquiries.
Link tracking, partner performance and referral traffic, reported by campaign.

groups.title: Experiences
items: Concept, speaker curation, registration, partners and delivery for focused gatherings.
Collabify’s own repeatable event formats, each with its own audience, programme and sponsorship model.
Pop-ups, roadshows, campus activations, sampling and interactive installations.
Podcast and interview lounges at events that turn conversations into content.

groups.title: Platform
items: A platform connecting brands with creators, communities, newsletters and publishers for managed campaigns. Not available yet: today we run these campaigns as a managed service.

faqs: Do you post in communities without permission?
No. We distribute only where community owners have agreed, and sponsored posts are always disclosed.
Do you have an existing creator network?
We source and qualify partners for each campaign based on audience fit, rather than pushing a fixed roster. [Update once your partner database is established.]
Is the marketplace live?
Not yet. Register interest below and we’ll share updates as it develops.

CAPS.desc: Permission-based distribution through creators, publishers, newsletters and communities, plus curated events and brand activations.

TOOLS.name: Growth Health Check
TOOLS.line: Score your brand, website, content, PR, operations, events and partnerships in 14 questions, and get your three priorities.

TOOLS.name: Media kit maker
TOOLS.line: A professional media kit and rate card to send to brands. Download it or share it as a link.

TOOLS.name: Event invite maker
TOOLS.line: A beautiful invite page with WhatsApp RSVP and add-to-calendar buttons. Share one link with every guest.

TOOLS.name: WhatsApp QR maker
TOOLS.line: A click-to-chat link and a printable QR poster, so customers can message you in one scan.

HC_QUESTIONS: How quickly can a stranger understand what you do and who it’s for?
How do new customers or leads mostly find you?
We don’t have a reliable source
One or two channels we run regularly
Several channels we track and improve
What does your website do for the business?
It exists but rarely brings enquiries
It’s a steady, tracked source of leads or sales
How much routine work is automated, such as forms, follow-ups, invoices and reports?
How often do you publish content, such as posts, videos or podcasts?
Does your founder or leadership have a visible public voice?
When someone searches your name or brand, what do they find?
Do you know what people and AI search tools say about your brand?
How are leads and customers tracked?
In a CRM everyone uses, with clear follow-ups
How documented are your key processes and roles?
How do you use events, webinars or meetups?
We attend others’ events now and then
We run a planned calendar that brings leads
After an event, what happens to the people you met?
They go into the CRM with a follow-up plan
Do creators, communities or partners promote you?
A managed creator and partner programme
Do you have a referral or partner programme?

brand: Start with positioning and one clear message, so every channel says the same thing.
tech: Make your website a tracked source of enquiries, and automate the repetitive work around it.
media: Build a steady content rhythm around your founder’s expertise, and get more from every recording.
pr: Earn third-party credibility, and keep watch over how your brand is described, including in AI search.
fos: Put every lead and customer in one system with clear follow-ups, and write down how work gets done.
events: Use events to meet the right buyers, and turn every contact into a tracked follow-up.
network: Let creators, communities and partners carry your story, with tracking on every placement.
